messages.text: Can I get my rma label
Used the customer-care skill
Used the chat-interview skill

Yes, the RMA form is the only way in, and the return label comes back to you once it's submitted: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Processing takes up to 10 days after the unit reaches the warehouse. One thing I have to ask first: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That isn't covered by warranty or RMA.
So your shipping out a box?

No box, just a label. You pack the unit in whatever you've got and the prepaid return label comes to you after the form goes in, so you print it and drop it off.

What's the unit doing, and was it ever overclocked?
So when you say rma label is on its way, what do you mean?

I mean emailed, not posted. Once you submit the RMA form, the team emails you a prepaid return label as a PDF to print and stick on your own packaging. Nothing physical arrives.

Have you already filled the form in, or do you still need to? And which unit is it?
I did and it said that someone would get back to me in two days- its been a week

That's a week too long, sorry. I can't mint the label myself, but I can put this in front of the team right now.

What's your order number and the email you used on the RMA form?
Order Shop····
Used the store-orders skill
Thanks. What's the email on the order? I need it to pull Shop···· up and get this moving.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · RMA label cannot be issued by me; form submitted ~1 week ago with no response pa

Got it, Zach. Your NerdQX from Shop···· was delivered August 10, so this is an RMA, and a week with no label isn't right.

I've pinged the team, one of them will jump into this chat shortly. Stay here if you can, and if you step away the label comes to (email hidden)

While we wait, what's the unit doing, and was it ever overclocked?
Never overclocked. Two error codes-vreg overheated and voltage protection

Stock settings with a VREG overheat usually means the regulator fan or airflow, so first check the fan actually spins and the heatsink is clear; if it trips again cold, that's a hardware fault and the RMA is the right route anyway. Never overclocked means you're covered.

For hands-on help right now, JD is on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post and mention @nullhashrate.

Anything else while the team comes in?
Tried to do a cold reset for a hour. Same thing within seconds of plugging it in.

That settles it, tripping cold in seconds is a hardware fault, not a setting. If you've got a spare PSU of the same rating, worth one swap test to rule the supply out, but either way this unit needs to come back.

I've added the fault detail to the team's note so the label comes with it. JD can also look at it live on Discord if you want a second opinion while you wait.
Ruff eta for team to respond in chat?

They're on until 6pm Eastern today, so there's a good chance someone picks it up within the hour. If it slips past that, the reply lands in your email at (email hidden), you don't have to sit here for it.

Want me to keep the chat open in the meantime?
No just email it thank

Done, Zach, it'll come to your email.

Before you go, one thing: you'd been waiting a week on the form, what made you chase it today rather than earlier?
Thank you
No problem, Zach. Watch your inbox for the label, and shout if anything else comes up.
